pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever watched a courtroom drama? There is a lawyer. There is a judge. There is a jury. The lawyer presents evidence. The lawyer calls witnesses. The lawyer shows documents. The lawyer makes a case. The jury listens. The jury decides. The verdict is based on evidence.


The Bible makes a case. It makes a case for Jesus. It presents evidence. It calls witnesses. It shows documents. The documents are the prophecies. The witnesses are the prophets. The evidence is the fulfillment. The case is overwhelming. The verdict is clear. Jesus is the Messiah.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who wants to see the evidence. It is for the person who wants to examine the case. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 pieces of evidence. We are going to see the prophecies. We are going to see the fulfillments. We are going to see the case for Jesus. And we are going to see the ultimate evidence.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see the Bible as a collection of stories. You will see it as a legal document. You will see it as a case file. You will understand the evidence. You will understand why it is so compelling. You will understand why it cannot be dismissed. You will see the hand of God in the details. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new appreciation for the ultimate evidence.


How to Use This Guide


This is a 30 day journey. Each day takes about 10 minutes. Read the hook. Read the ancient evidence. Read the fulfillment. Read the verdict. Read the resonance. Read the prayer. If you are not sure how to pray, just read the words out loud. God hears honest words. He is not looking for fancy l...

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a courtroom? There is a judge. There is a jury. There is a lawyer. The lawyer presents evidence. The lawyer makes a case. The case is built on facts. The case is built on proof. The Bible makes a case. It makes a case for Jesus. It presents evidence. It presents the evidence of the seed. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel." - Genesis 3:15 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


This is the first prophecy in the Bible. God is speaking to a snake. But He is not just speaking to a snake. He is speaking to the devil. He says a descendant of a woman will come. That descendant will crush the serpent's head. It sounds like a riddle. It sounds like a code. It is the first piece of evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law..." - Galatians 4:4


Jesus is that descendant. He was born of a woman. He came to crush the serpent's head. He came to defeat the devil. On the cross, it looked like the serpent won. But three days later, He rose from the dead. The serpent's head was crushed. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is not a coincidence. The first prophecy in the Bible is about a hero. The greatest hero in the Bible is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The evidence is precise. The case is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like the snake is winning? Do you feel like the enemy is too strong? Remember the first prophecy. The hero is coming. The hero has come. The serpent's head is crushed. You are on the winning side.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the first prophecy. Thank you for the promise of a hero. Thank you for Jesus. Thank you for crushing the serpent's head. Thank you for winning the victory. Help me to live in that victory today. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a family tree? It shows you the roots. It shows you the branches. It shows you the descendants. The Bible has a family tree. It is evidence. It is evidence of a promise. It is evidence of a blessing. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you." - Genesis 12:3 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


God spoke to Abraham. He told him to leave his home. He gave him a promise. He said, "I will bless you. I will make your name great. You will be a blessing. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you." This was a huge promise. It meant that one day, someone from Abraham's family would change the world. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham..." - Matthew 1:1


The Gospel of Matthew opens with a family tree. It traces the line of Jesus back to Abraham. It shows that Jesus is a descendant of Abraham. He is the one who brings blessing to the whole world. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
For this prophecy to be fulfilled, the Messiah had to be Jewish. He had to come from a specific family line. The odds of this being a coincidence are tiny. The evidence is strong. The case is clear.


The Resonance
You are not an accident. You are part of a bigger story. God's plan is not just for one person. It is for the whole world. And you are included. You are part of the evidence.


The Prayer
God, thank you for keeping your promises. Thank you that your plan has always been bigger than one person or one nation. Thank you that Jesus came to bless the whole world, including me. Help me to see that I am part of your story. Help me to share the blessing with others. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a royal family? They have a lineage. They have a history. They have a throne. The Bible has a royal family. It is evidence. It is evidence of a king. It is evidence of a kingdom. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his." - Genesis 49:10 (Written around 1800 B.C.)


Jacob was dying. He gathered his twelve sons around his bed. He gave each son a blessing. When he got to Judah, he said something strange. He said the scepter would not depart from Judah. A scepter is a stick a king holds. Jacob was saying that the line of kings would come from Judah. He was saying that one day, the ultimate King would come. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah..." - Hebrews 7:14


Jesus was from the tribe of Judah. The New Testament makes this clear. He is the King of Kings. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
The Jewish people had twelve tribes. They were all different. But the Messiah had to come from one specific tribe. The odds of this being random are small. The evidence is strong. The case is clear.


The Resonance
History is not random. It is not just a bunch of accidents. There is a pattern hidden in the chaos. God is not just watching. God is directing. The evidence is real.


The Prayer
God, you are the King of Kings. Thank you for your plan that unfolds across thousands of years. Thank you that you are in control of history. Thank you that you are in control of my history. Help me to trust you with my future. Help me to trust you with my life. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a star? It is a light in the sky. It is a sign. It is a guide. The Bible has a star. It is evidence. It is evidence of a king. It is evidence of a birth. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel." - Numbers 24:17 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Balaam was a pagan prophet. God used him to speak. He said a star would come out of Jacob. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him." - Matthew 2:2


When Jesus was born, wise men came from the east. They saw a star in the sky. The star led them to Jesus. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a strange prophecy. It was spoken by a nonbeliever. It connects a star to a king. The story of the wise men lines up perfectly. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
The stars themselves were pointing to a king. The universe is not silent. It speaks. It points. The evidence is in the sky.


The Prayer
God, the heavens declare your glory. Thank you for putting signs in the sky that point to Jesus. Thank you for the wise men who followed the star. Help me to follow the clues that lead to you. Help me to seek you with all my heart. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: The Evidence of the Star

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a prophet? They are messengers. They are voices. They are spokesmen. The Bible has a prophet. It is evidence. It is evidence of a voice. It is evidence of a message. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him." - Deuteronomy 18:18 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Moses said God would raise up a prophet like him. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For Moses said, 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.'" - Acts 3:22


Peter applied this to Jesus. Jesus is the new Moses. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
The Jews were waiting for this prophet. Jesus fulfilled that expectation. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
We are not just looking for a teacher. We are looking for a liberator. Jesus is both. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
God, thank you for sending Jesus. He is greater than Moses. He speaks your words. Help me to listen to Him. Help me to follow Him. Set me free from the things that hold me back. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: The Evidence of the Prophet

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a branch? It grows from a tree. It bears fruit. It is evidence of life. The Bible has a branch. It is evidence. It is evidence of a king. It is evidence of a kingdom. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse; from his roots a Branch will bear fruit." - Isaiah 11:1 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said a Branch would come from the stump of Jesse. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"And again, Isaiah says, 'The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; in him the Gentiles will hope.'" - Romans 15:12


Jesus is that Branch. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
The prophet Isaiah said a dead stump would come alive. Jesus fulfilled that. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
God specializes in bringing life out of broken things. The evidence is real.


The Prayer
God, you bring life out of dead things. Thank you for the Branch that grew from the stump of Jesse. Thank you for Jesus. I ask you to bring new life to the broken places in my heart. Bring new life to my dreams. Bring new life to my family. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: The Evidence of the Branch

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a miracle? It is something impossible. It is something supernatural. The Bible has a miracle. It is evidence. It is evidence of a birth. It is evidence of a sign. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel." - Isaiah 7:14 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said a virgin would give birth. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel" (which means "God with us"). - Matthew 1:23


Mary was a virgin. She gave birth to Jesus. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about a miracle. It requires a supernatural event. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
We serve a God who does impossible things. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
God, you are the God of the impossible. Thank you for sending Jesus, born of a virgin. Thank you that you are with us. Help me to believe that you can do impossible things in my life. Help me to trust you with the impossible. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: The Evidence of the Virgin Birth

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a town? It is a place. It is a home. It is a birthplace. The Bible has a town. It is evidence. It is evidence of a birthplace. It is evidence of a prophecy. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times." - Micah 5:2 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Micah said the ruler would come from Bethlehem. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"So Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of David, because he belonged to the house and line of David." - Luke 2:4


Jesus was born in Bethlehem. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
It is statistically impossible to orchestrate your own birthplace. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
God pays attention to details. The evidence is in the details.


The Prayer
God, thank you for caring about details. Thank you for planning every step of your son's life. Thank you that you care about my life too. Help me to trust you with the small things. Help me to trust you with the big things. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: The Evidence of Bethlehem

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a child? They are small. They are helpless. They are dependent. The Bible has a child. It is evidence. It is evidence of a king. It is evidence of a savior. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said the child would be Mighty God. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"I and the Father are one." - John 10:30


Jesus claimed to be God. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
Jesus claimed to be God. The prophecy said the child would be Mighty God. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
Spirituality is not just about reaching up. The Divine reached down. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, you are Mighty God. Thank you for coming to earth. Thank you for stepping down from heaven. Thank you for being the Everlasting Father. Help me to know you more. Help me to love you more. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: The Evidence of the Child

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a journey? It is a trip. It is a route. It is a destination. The Bible has a journey. It is evidence. It is evidence of a refugee. It is evidence of a king. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son." - Hosea 11:1 (Written around 750 B.C.)


Hosea said God called His son out of Egypt. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt, where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: 'Out of Egypt I called my son.'" - Matthew 2:14-15


Jesus was taken to Egypt. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a strange prophecy. It was originally about Israel. But Matthew applies it to Jesus. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
Jesus knows what it feels like to be displaced. The evidence is personal.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for understanding what it feels like to be afraid. Thank you for being with me when I am scared. Thank you for protecting me. Thank you for being my refuge. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: The Evidence of Egypt

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen grief? It is a tear. It is a cry. It is a sorrow. The Bible has grief. It is evidence. It is evidence of a mother. It is evidence of a prophecy. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"This is what the LORD says: 'A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.'" - Jeremiah 31:15 (Written around 600 B.C.)


Jeremiah said there would be weeping in Ramah. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under..." - Matthew 2:16


The mothers wept. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a dark prophecy. But even in the darkness, the prophecy was fulfilled. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
The Bible does not ignore pain. The evidence is real.


The Prayer
God, you see my tears. You know my pain. Thank you for not ignoring my suffering. Thank you for being with me in the darkness. Comfort me today. Comfort those who are grieving. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: The Evidence of Weeping

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a voice? It is a sound. It is a message. It is a messenger. The Bible has a voice. It is evidence. It is evidence of a prophet. It is evidence of a preparation. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"A voice of one calling: 'In the wilderness prepare the way for the LORD; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.'" - Isaiah 40:3 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said there would be a voice in the wilderness. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea and saying, 'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.'" - Matthew 3:1-3


John the Baptist was that voice. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
The Jews were waiting for this voice. Jesus fulfilled that. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
Every spiritual awakening begins with preparation. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the voices that point to Jesus. Thank you for the people who prepared the way for me to know you. Prepare my heart for what you have for me. Help me to be ready. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: The Evidence of the Voice

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a healer? They are a doctor. They are a medicine. They are a cure. The Bible has a healer. It is evidence. It is evidence of a servant. It is evidence of a savior. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"The Spirit of the Sovereign LORD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners..." - Isaiah 61:1 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said the Spirit of the Lord would anoint a healer. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"He went to Nazareth... and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue... He stood up to read... 'The Spirit of the Lord is on me...' Then he began to say to them, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'" - Luke 4:16-21


Jesus applied this to Himself. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
Jesus quoted this passage and applied it to Himself. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
This is your inheritance. Jesus came to heal your broken heart. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, you are the healer. Thank you for binding up my broken heart. Thank you for setting me free from the things that hold me captive. Thank you for the good news. Heal me today. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: The Evidence of the Spirit

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen light? It is a lamp. It is a star. It is a guide. The Bible has light. It is evidence. It is evidence of a mission. It is evidence of a ministry. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of deep darkness a light has dawned." - Isaiah 9:2 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said a light would dawn in Galilee. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum... to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah... the people living in darkness have seen a great light..." - Matthew 4:13-16


Jesus brought light to Galilee. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a geographical prophecy. Jesus fulfilled it. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
God meets you where you are. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the light in the darkness. Thank you for shining your light in the dark places. Shine your light into my heart today. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: The Evidence of Light

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a stone? It is a rock. It is a building block. It is a cornerstone. The Bible has a stone. It is evidence. It is evidence of rejection. It is evidence of vindication. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the LORD has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes." - Psalm 118:22 (Written around 500 B.C.)


The builders rejected the stone. But it became the cornerstone. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes" - Matthew 21:42


Jesus applied this to Himself. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about rejection and vindication. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
When others reject you, remember that God sees your worth. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
God, thank you that you see my worth. Thank you that you do not reject me. Thank you that Jesus was rejected so that I could be accepted. Help me to find my worth in you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: The Evidence of the Stone

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen hatred? It is a look. It is a word. It is a deed. The Bible has hatred. It is evidence. It is evidence of rejection. It is evidence of a cause. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head..." - Psalm 69:4 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David was hated for no reason. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"They hated me without reason." - John 15:25


Jesus said the world hated Him without a reason. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the rejection of the Messiah. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
If you are hated for doing the right thing, you are in good company. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for enduring hatred for me. Thank you for loving me even when others hated you. Help me to love those who hate me. Help me to forgive those who hurt me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: The Evidence of Hatred

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen betrayal? It is a kiss. It is a knife. It is a friend. The Bible has betrayal. It is evidence. It is evidence of a close friend. It is evidence of a traitor. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me." - Psalm 41:9 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David was betrayed by a close friend. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"He who shared my bread has turned against me." - John 13:18


Jesus was betrayed by Judas. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about intimate betrayal. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
The greatest pain is not from enemies. Jesus understands. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for understanding the pain of betrayal. Thank you for being a friend who never betrays. Heal my heart from the wounds of broken friendships. Help me to trust again. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Evidence of Betrayal

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen silver? It is a coin. It is a price. It is a payment. The Bible has silver. It is evidence. It is evidence of a betrayal. It is evidence of a price. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"So they paid me thirty pieces of silver..." - Zechariah 11:12 (Written around 500 B.C.)


Zechariah was paid thirty pieces of silver. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"So they counted out for him thirty pieces of silver." - Matthew 26:15


Judas betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the exact amount of money. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
Jesus allowed Himself to be valued at the price of a slave. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for valuing me enough to humble yourself. Thank you for allowing yourself to be sold for thirty pieces of silver. Thank you for loving me that much. Help me to see my worth in you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Evidence of Silver

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen silence? It is a quiet. It is a pause. It is a peace. The Bible has silence. It is evidence. It is evidence of a trial. It is evidence of a lamb. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth..." - Isaiah 53:7 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said the servant would be silent. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge..." - Matthew 27:14


Jesus was silent during His trial. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the behavior of the Messiah during his trial. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
Sometimes the most powerful thing you can do is be silent. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being silent so that I could speak to God. Thank you for enduring false accusations. Help me to trust you when I am accused. Help me to be silent when I need to be. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Evidence of Silence

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a flock? It is a group. It is a family. It is a gathering. The Bible has a flock. It is evidence. It is evidence of a shepherd. It is evidence of a scattering. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered..." - Zechariah 13:7 (Written around 500 B.C.)


Zechariah said the shepherd would be struck. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered." - Matthew 26:31


Jesus quoted this prophecy. The disciples ran away. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the disciples. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
Even when you fail or run away, Jesus does not abandon you. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for never giving up on me. Thank you for coming after me when I run away. Thank you for being the Good Shepherd. Help me to stop running. Help me to stay close to you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Evidence of the Scattered Sheep

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a criminal? They are a lawbreaker. They are a prisoner. They are a sinner. The Bible has criminals. It is evidence. It is evidence of a crucifixion. It is evidence of a substitution. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"He was numbered with the transgressors..." - Isaiah 53:12 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said the Messiah would be numbered with the transgressors. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed..." - Luke 23:32-33


Jesus was crucified between two criminals. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the method of execution. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance
The innocent was treated like the guilty so the guilty could be set free. The evidence is clear.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being numbered with the criminals so I could be numbered with the saints. Thank you for forgiving me. Thank you for taking my place. Help me to forgive others. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Evidence of the Criminals

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a wound? It is a mark. It is a scar. It is a pain. The Bible has a wound. It is evidence. It is evidence of a crucifixion. It is evidence of a sacrifice. It is the ultimate evidence.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"They pierce my hands and my feet." - Psalm 22:16 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David said the Messiah would have pierced hands and feet. It was evidence.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Unless I see the nail marks in his hands..." - John 20:25


Thomas saw the nail marks in Jesus' hands. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Verdict
Crucifixion did not exist when David wrote this. The evidence is strong.


The Resonance

The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for the scars you bear for me. Thank you for the nail marks in your hands. Thank you for loving me that much. Help me to never forget your sacrifice. Amen.

The Hook

The Ancient Evidence (OT)

pages.title: Day 29: The Evidence of Ascension

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a case? It is a trial. It is a verdict. It is a decision. The Bible has a case. It is evidence. It is the ultimate evidence. It is the case for Jesus.


The Ancient Evidence (OT)
"These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ." - Colossians 2:17


All the prophecies were shadows. They were clues. They were pointing to Jesus. The evidence was presented. The case was made.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed." - 1 Corinthians 5:7


Jesus is the real evidence. He is the fulfillment of every prophecy. He is the meaning behind every clue. He is the treasure at the end of the hunt. When we connect the dots, we find Jesus. He was there all along.


The Verdict
The evidence is overwhelming. The case is clear. The verdict is in. Jesus is the Messiah. He is the Son of God. He is the Savior of the world.


The Resonance
You have seen the evidence. You have examined the case. You have heard the verdict. Now what? You can believe. You can trust. You can follow. The evidence is on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the ultimate evidence. Thank you for being the fulfillment of every prophecy. Thank you for being the treasure. Help me to live in the reality. Help me to live in you. I love you. Amen.



END MATTER


The 300+ Prophecy Challenge
We only looked at 30 prophecies in this book. The Bible contains over 300 prophecies about Jesus. If you want to keep investigating, I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It tells the story of Jesus from the perspective of an eyewitness. As you read, look for the clues. Look for the prophecies. Look for the evidence. You will be amazed at what you find.


The Probability Factor
Mathematicians have calculated the probability of one person fulfilling just eight of these prophecies. The odds are 1 in 10 to the 17th power. That is a one with seventeen zeros after it. That is the same as covering the entire state of Texas with silver coins, marking one coin, and having a blindfolded person pick the right coin on the first try. Jesus fulfilled not eight. Not thirty. Over three hundred. The math points to a miracle.


A Note on Faith
Evidence is important. It satisfies the mind. But evidence does not save you. The evidence points to a person. The evidence points to Jesus. You can believe the facts and still be far from God. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The evidence is on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the evidence that the Bible is true. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.
